source_text: The rest of the walkthrough stays in the eighty-kilobase example. The Proteins editor defines each species independently. Expand builder gives these settings room. Set abundance, free diffusion, binding valence, mark preferences, and occupied-versus-vacant capture and release factors. A species can also write or erase a mark, or remodel nucleosomes. An IDR representation expands a molecule into a flexible chain of domain beads with binding stickers. This supports higher-order assemblies, but it is not an amino-acid-resolved protein model. Choose roles and interactions as explicit hypotheses; a biological name is not a calibrated parameter set.
